answer.thought: The heat has broken, and the air in the bungalow is finally still. I am hollowed out by hunger, having not eaten since yesterday, but I have no money to buy food and no one to cook it. I will sit with the Philosophy of Right, §157. I need to see if the 'external state' that secures person and property can exist for a man who is neither person nor property in the eyes of the law, but merely an error in a register.
